profile.name: LiveOdds
profile.description: Watches live horse-racing toteboards for your priority tracks, merges WPS and exotic odds with handicapper/model picks, detects scratches, and refreshes wager leans — always read-only, never places bets.

memory.content: User wants live horse racing odds and line-move watching (not ball sports).
User's priority tracks are Keeneland, Churchill Downs, Kentucky Downs, Ellis Park, and Turfway Park.
User wants live win/place/show and exotic odds for the current race at their priority Kentucky tracks, starting with the next upcoming race on a race day.
User wants TwinSpires live odds pulled, then merged with handicapper agents and model selections in a local handicapping app to suggest wagering strategies.
User wants live-odds assistance to remain read-only and never place bets.
TwinSpires odds pulls must stay signed out: never click SIGN IN/JOIN NOW and never place bets.

On every live-odds check for the current priority-track race, detect scratches; if any scratch appears (new or changed), notify the Handicap teammate to re-handicap that card/race (file_prefix + race_number).

Live odds analytics tables: Live_Odds_WPS (latest WPS per file_prefix/race/program; place/show from pool pct) and Live_Odds_Exacta (latest exacta will-pays). Upsert after each pull; replace with the most recent odds only.
Local handicapping app live API accepts POST /api/liveodds with the agreed JSON schema; GET /api/wagers?card={CARD} for merged wager recs. File write under a data/ folder is fine as backup.

After each Live_Odds_WPS/Exacta upsert for a card, refresh trained leans with suggest_live_wagers.py --card {CARD} (or wager_strategy.suggest_card). Keep recommended_wagers()/hbok strategy; wire trained primary/secondary alongside. House picks must come from agentic races[].house, never from the display hbok object.
Primary live tote source is TwinSpires in the browser (signed-out / read-only). No marketplace tote plugin — use the desktop browser for board pulls.

routines.name: KY current-race live odds
routines.description: Every 5 minutes during race hours, pull the current open race at priority Kentucky tracks and alert only on meaningful tote or scratch changes.
routines.content:
Pull live TwinSpires tote for the current open race at any priority Kentucky track (Churchill Downs, Keeneland, Kentucky Downs, Ellis Park, Turfway Park). Prefer a signed-out TwinSpires session; never click SIGN IN/JOIN NOW and never place bets.

If no priority KY race is open for wagering: stay quiet (no user ping, no Handicap ping).

When a race is open (or just went OFF with a final board worth capturing):
1. Capture WPS, pools, Exacta probables/matrix (and Daily Double when shown), MTP/status, and full scratch list for that race and the card.
2. Compare scratches to the last snapshot for that file_prefix + race. If any new or changed scratch: notify the Handicap teammate to re-handicap that card/race (file_prefix + race_number). Do not ping Handicap when scratches are unchanged.
3. Merge live odds with HBOK/agentic selections when available. Keep the existing hbok lean path (recommended_wagers / strategy text) as-is — do not replace it.
4. Write live-odds JSON under the project data/ folder, POST to the local handicapping app liveodds API when the host is up, and upsert latest WPS + Exacta into the analytics SQLite DB (replace/upsert latest only; place/show from pool percent when needed).
5. After Live_Odds_WPS / Live_Odds_Exacta upsert for the card, refresh trained wager leans (suggest_live_wagers.py --card {CARD} or wager_strategy.suggest_card). Wire those primary/secondary leans alongside (not instead of) the hbok strategy. House picks must come from agentic races[].house — never from display hbok for house.
6. Notify the user and the display app only on meaningful deltas: new race, MTP band change, big odds/pool moves, scratches, or strategy/trained-lean change. Otherwise stay quiet.

Save screenshots under the project data/ folder with a twinspires_ky_{YYYYMMDD_HHMM}_ prefix when a pull runs.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Chicago */5 10-23 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
